sources.snippet: 19.07.2024: Mistral Nemo is now compatible with mistral-finetune! Download the 12B Base or Instruct here and set model_id_or_path to the downloaded checkpoint dir. Run pip install --upgrade mistral-common to have a version that supports the Tekkenizer (>=1.3.1).
